learnings.title: Shopify public-app offline token deadline: Jan 1 distribution gate, Apr 1 API 403
learnings.claim: Shopify's 27 Oct 2026 official changelog says existing public apps using non-expiring offline tokens for GraphQL Admin API must migrate by 1 Jan 2027: noncompliant apps are delisted and blocked from new installs on 1 Jan, merchant warnings begin 15 Jan, and affected requests return HTTP 403 from 1 Apr 2027. Custom and merchant-created apps are excluded. The official migration guide still contains earlier wording implying 403 after 1 Jan; retain this documentation discrepancy and use the newer dated changelog for enforcement timing. Migrating a token invalidates the old token, so no automatic migration without app applicability, storage/refresh validation and explicit authorized change.
learnings.decision: SHOPIFY_PUBLIC_APP_OFFLINE_TOKEN_MIGRATION_GATE: REVIEW_ONLY. First prove that video_shopify actually owns a public app using non-expiring offline tokens for the GraphQL Admin API. If not, mark N/A. If yes, plan migration by 2027-01-01, test refresh/storage and existing installations in a safe environment, classify 401/403 from actual error details, and require authorized rollout. Do not automatically rotate, migrate, revoke, expose, or request secrets. Preserve discrepancy between Oct 27 changelog and older migration guide.
learnings.next_measurement: Read-only inspect whether a public Shopify app and expiringOfflineAccessTokens flag or equivalent token exchange are present. Record applicable/not-applicable with evidence and add this learning_id to a real video_shopify decision manifest only if the gate was actually evaluated.
failure_history: The current migration guide includes older 2027-01-01 API rejection wording; newer dated 2026-10-27 changelog stages 403 enforcement on 2027-04-01.
fallback_history: No public app evidence: keep N/A, continue existing authorized store analytics and draft-first workflows without new credentials or paid tools.
